name: varsha-furniture
description: Varsha Furniture - Handcrafted Furniture Ahmedabad & Cloudflare D1 Backend

scripts.db:count:local: wrangler d1 execute varsha-db --local --command="SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products) as products, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM categories) as categories, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders) as orders;"
